zh_points: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋被曝与疑似中国间谍的女性有染，公司已启动独立调查。
该女子名为Alice Hang，是美国情报官员认为为中国情报机构工作的人员，与新加坡公司Mega Speed有关联。
黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠并道歉，但英伟达董事会表示没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全受到损害。
事件引发对特朗普政府是否早已知情的质疑，以及对中国利用商业关系获取美国AI芯片技术的担忧。
丑闻发生在AI行业政治审查加强和市场动荡之际，可能影响英伟达的领导层稳定和整个AI板块。
en_points: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is alleged to have had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, prompting an independent investigation by the company.
The woman, Alice Hang, is believed by US intelligence to have worked for China's spy agency and is linked to Singapore-based Mega Speed, a major Nvidia customer.
Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and apologized, while Nvidia's board expressed confidence in him and said no secrets were compromised.
The scandal raises questions about whether President Trump was briefed on the intelligence and what it means for the US-China AI race.
The timing is sensitive as the AI sector faces political scrutiny and market turbulence, with potential implications for Nvidia's leadership and the broader AI industry.

deconstruction.overview: 文章以新闻播报形式展开，通过主持人串联、记者报道和专家评论，逐步揭露英伟达CEO黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的绯闻及其影响。结构上先抛出爆炸性标题，再梳理已知事实，接着深入背景分析，最后讨论政治和市场影响。风格上混合了新闻报道、人物访谈和分析评论，语言生动但保持客观。

sections.title: 引爆丑闻
sections.argument: 黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍有染，事件极具爆炸性。
sections.evidence: 引用报道称中国间谍机构招募女性 targeting 黄仁勋，并可能影响英伟达。
sections.technique: 使用电影比喻（James Bond）和直接引语制造悬念。

sections.title: 事件影响与反应
sections.argument: 丑闻可能影响黄仁勋的CEO职位，并对公司和市场产生重大影响。
sections.evidence: 提到黄仁勋可能被免职，英伟达规模与苹果相当，芯片驱动AI应用；引用专家称事件可能戳破股市泡沫。
sections.technique: 使用专家评论和假设性语句强调潜在后果。

sections.title: 已知事实梳理
sections.argument: 英伟达已启动独立调查，黄仁勋承认不忠并道歉，但董事会支持他。
sections.evidence: 引用纽约时报报道，提供英伟达市值4.5万亿美元，黄仁勋领导30年，受欢迎程度（Jensenity），以及他的道歉声明。
sections.technique: 使用具体数据和直接引语增强可信度。

sections.title: 黄仁勋与英伟达的背景
sections.argument: 黄仁勋是科技界巨头，英伟达是AI芯片的关键供应商。
sections.evidence: 记者Shauna McCullum描述黄仁勋的皮衣形象、与粉丝自拍，英伟达芯片用于视频游戏和AI如ChatGPT。
sections.technique: 使用生动细节和比喻（皮衣、自拍）塑造人物形象。

sections.title: 疑似间谍Alice Hang的身份
sections.argument: Alice Hang与Mega Speed有关联，该公司被指控为中国提供后门 access。
sections.evidence: Tessa Wong报道称Hang是Mega Speed高管，美国官员认为她为中国收集情报；商业记录显示她曾担任董事。
sections.technique: 使用调查性报道元素，如商业记录和实地探访被拒。

sections.title: 专家评论与调查细节
sections.argument: 专家认为黄仁勋被骗，调查由独立董事领导，董事会希望他留任。
sections.evidence: 引用Steven Wit称Hang有危险信号，Lily Jamali称无明确继任计划，中国外交部否认指控。
sections.technique: 使用直接引语和专家身份增强权威性。

sections.title: 政治影响与特朗普的反应
sections.argument: 特朗普可能早已知情，事件对共和党构成政治风险。
sections.evidence: 纽约时报报道特朗普去年听取简报，但今年5月黄仁勋仍随团访华；特朗普称黄是好人；民主党人将调查。
sections.technique: 使用时间线对比和直接引语揭示矛盾。

sections.title: 出口管制与AI竞赛
sections.argument: 美国对华芯片出口管制使英伟达失去中国市场，黄仁勋主张开放以保持美国标准。
sections.evidence: 提到2022年出口管制，黄仁勋9月采访称AI竞赛非零和，应让中国使用美国技术栈。
sections.technique: 使用背景信息和直接引语展示政策分歧。

sections.title: 市场影响与继任问题
sections.argument: 丑闻发生在AI市场敏感期，可能加剧市场波动，且英伟达继任计划不明确。
sections.evidence: 提到上周AI股票大跌，民主党中期选举胜利引发担忧；特朗普持有英伟达股份；黄仁勋子女在公司任职但无明确继任者。
sections.technique: 使用市场数据和专家分析强调不确定性。

writing_techniques.name: 电影比喻开场
writing_techniques.example: It's like something out of a James Bond movie.
writing_techniques.effect: 立即吸引读者，将现实事件与虚构间谍故事类比，增强戏剧性。

writing_techniques.name: 直接引语穿插
writing_techniques.example: >> You know, I think he's an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse.
writing_techniques.effect: 通过特朗普的直接引语展示其态度，增加报道的真实性和生动性。

writing_techniques.name: 数据支撑
writing_techniques.effect: 用具体市值强调英伟达的重要性，使读者直观感受事件影响规模。

writing_techniques.name: 专家身份标注
writing_techniques.example: Steven Wit. He's an investigative journalist and author of a biography on Jensen Huang.
writing_techniques.effect: 通过专家背景增强评论的可信度和权威性。

writing_techniques.name: 时间线对比
writing_techniques.example: The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Hang was spying on China's behalf. Yet in May this year, Jensen Huang joined Donald Trump's delegation of highlevel tech bosses to China
writing_techniques.effect: 揭示政府可能早已知情却未行动的矛盾，引发读者质疑。

background.event_context: 事件发生在中美科技竞争加剧的背景下，美国通过出口管制限制中国获取先进AI芯片，而中国则试图通过多种手段获取技术。英伟达作为AI芯片龙头，处于地缘政治漩涡中心。同时，美国国内政治极化，中期选举后民主党加强对科技行业的审查。

key_facts.fact: 英伟达市值达4.5万亿美元，是全球最有价值公司之一。
黄仁勋领导英伟达超过30年。
Alice Hang自2023年起与Mega Speed有关联，并曾担任其董事。
特朗普被曝去年已听取关于Alice Hang的简报。
美国自2022年起对华实施AI芯片出口管制。

background.author_stance: 文章以客观报道为主，但通过选择引语和细节（如专家称黄仁勋被骗、特朗普的模糊回应）暗示对黄仁勋的同情和对政府监管不力的质疑。整体倾向是揭示事件复杂性和潜在影响，而非简单谴责。
background.implications: 对英伟达而言，领导层稳定性和公司声誉面临考验；对AI行业，事件可能加剧市场波动和监管压力；对政策制定者，需平衡国家安全与商业利益；对读者，提醒在科技地缘政治中个人关系的风险。

actionable_skills.skill: 用比喻开场吸引注意力
actionable_skills.how_to_apply: 在写作或演讲开头，用一个广为人知的电影、书籍或文化典故类比当前事件，制造悬念。
actionable_skills.example: 写一篇关于商业间谍的文章，开头可以写：'这听起来像一部约翰·勒卡雷的小说：一位科技巨头被卷入一场国际间谍游戏。'

actionable_skills.skill: 穿插直接引语增强真实感
actionable_skills.how_to_apply: 在报道或分析中，直接引用关键人物的原话，尤其是那些带有情绪或矛盾的表态，让读者自行判断。
actionable_skills.example: 在写政治评论时，引用官员的原话：'I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what is going on.' 然后分析其含糊其辞。

actionable_skills.how_to_apply: 在介绍一个公司或事件时，尽早给出关键数据（如市值、用户数、增长率），让读者快速理解规模。
actionable_skills.example: 写一家初创公司，开头写：'这家成立仅三年的公司估值已突破100亿美元，是增长最快的SaaS企业之一。'

actionable_skills.skill: 通过时间线对比揭示矛盾
actionable_skills.how_to_apply: 梳理事件的关键时间点，将早期信息与后续行动并列，让矛盾自然浮现。
actionable_skills.example: 写一篇关于企业合规的文章：'该公司早在2022年就收到内部举报，却直到2023年监管调查启动后才采取行动。'

thinking_models.model: 零和博弈 vs 非零和博弈
thinking_models.explanation: 零和博弈指一方所得即另一方所失，非零和博弈则存在双赢可能。
thinking_models.how_to_use: 在分析国际竞争或商业策略时，判断局势是否为零和。例如，黄仁勋认为AI竞赛非零和，美国可通过开放技术栈保持领导地位。

thinking_models.explanation: 通过观察异常特征（如缺乏相关背景、公司突然崛起）来评估潜在风险。
thinking_models.how_to_use: 在商业合作或投资决策中，列出关键风险指标。例如，Steven Wit指出Alice Hang没有商业和计算机背景，Mega Speed突然出现，这些都是危险信号。

thinking_models.explanation: 政治决策和商业利益相互影响，需同时考虑两者。
thinking_models.how_to_use: 分析企业事件时，思考政治因素（如选举、监管）如何影响商业环境。例如，中期选举后民主党加强对AI审查，可能影响英伟达的政策环境。

thinking_models.explanation: 关键人物风险是公司治理的核心问题，缺乏继任计划可能导致危机。
thinking_models.how_to_use: 评估公司时，检查是否有明确的继任计划。例如，英伟达没有明显继任者，黄仁勋的丑闻可能引发领导层危机。

recitation.advice: 本文为新闻访谈体，长句较多，建议在引号处和句号处换气。用关键词串起全文：Jensen Huang、Nvidia、Chinese spy、Alice Hang、investigation、Trump、AI chips、export controls、market impact。背诵时注意人名和公司名的统一（Jensen Huang/Wong/Wang 等原文有变体，背诵时以原文为准）。

chunks.text: It's like something out of a James Bond movie. One of the most powerful tech bosses in the world, pivotal in the global AI arms race, admitting he's had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
chunks.hint: James Bond, tech boss, affair, spy
chunks.translation: 这就像詹姆斯·邦德电影里的情节。全球最有权势的科技老板之一，在全球人工智能军备竞赛中举足轻重，承认他与一名疑似中国间谍有婚外情。

chunks.text: An explosive new report is claiming China's top spy agency recruited a woman to target Nvidia CEO Jensen Wong.
chunks.hint: explosive report, spy agency, recruited, target
chunks.translation: 一份爆炸性的新报告声称，中国最高间谍机构招募了一名女子来针对英伟达CEO黄仁勋。

chunks.text: Wong may be removed as CEO depending on the outcome of the investigations, which is a huge deal for a company that's as large as Apple. His computer chips helped power everything from video games to chat bots like chat GPT.
chunks.hint: removed as CEO, investigation, huge deal, chips
chunks.translation: 黄仁勋可能会根据调查结果被免去CEO职务，这对一家和苹果一样大的公司来说可是件大事。他的电脑芯片为从电子游戏到ChatGPT等聊天机器人的一切提供了动力。

chunks.text: You know, I think he's an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse. You know, he fell for it and he got played. It's a It's a tale as old as time.
chunks.hint: honorable, excuse, fell for it, played
chunks.translation: 你知道，我觉得他是个体面的人。我想他大概有他的理由。你知道，他上当了，他被耍了。这是个老掉牙的故事。

chunks.text: It's a shock. And we know that these shocks tend to reverberate around the market. And if this causes the stock market bubble or the boom, depending on what your perspective is, to burst, the implications will be really potentially very significant.
chunks.hint: shock, reverberate, bubble, burst
chunks.translation: 这是一个冲击。我们知道这些冲击往往会在市场上引起反响。如果这导致股市泡沫或繁荣（取决于你的视角）破裂，其影响可能真的非常重大。

chunks.text: In a moment, we'll find out about the alleged Chinese spy at the center of this and what information she could have passed to Beijing. Whether the US president knew and when, and what it could mean for the race for AI dominance. But first, this is what we know so far.

chunks.translation: 稍后，我们将了解处于事件中心的所谓中国间谍，以及她可能向北京传递了什么信息。美国总统是否知情以及何时知情，以及这对人工智能主导权竞赛可能意味着什么。但首先，这是我们目前所知的情况。

chunks.text: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its boss, Jensen Hang, had a relationship with a businesswoman, Alice Hang. US intelligence officials believe the Chinese businesswoman was a spy for Beijing.
chunks.hint: Nvidia, independent investigation, relationship, spy
chunks.translation: 美国科技巨头英伟达已展开独立调查，此前有报道称其老板黄仁勋与女商人Alice Hang有染。美国情报官员认为这名中国女商人是北京方面的间谍。

chunks.text: According to the New York Times, worth $4.5 trillion dollars, Nvidia is one of the world's most valuable companies and a key player in AI infrastructure. Hang has been in charge for more than 30 years.
chunks.hint: New York Times, $4.5 trillion, valuable, 30 years
chunks.translation: 据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达市值4.5万亿美元，是全球最有价值的公司之一，也是人工智能基础设施的关键参与者。黄仁勋已掌舵30多年。

chunks.text: Unlike many tech CEOs, Hang is a hugely popular figure. Taiwanese media coined the term Jensenity to describe the level of adoration he generates when visiting Taiwan where he was born.
chunks.hint: popular, Jensenity, adoration, Taiwan
chunks.translation: 与许多科技CEO不同，黄仁勋是一位非常受欢迎的人物。台湾媒体创造了“Jensenity”一词来描述他访问出生地台湾时引发的崇拜程度。

chunks.text: Jensen Huang admitted to having been unfaithful to his wife and apologized for hurting her and their children in a statement shared with Nvidia staff. He also apologized to Nvidia's employees, board of shareholders, saying he had fallen short of his responsibilities.

chunks.text: Nvidia said its board had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, adding that Hang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Hang said he will cooperate fully with the investigation.
chunks.hint: board, no reason, secrets, cooperate
chunks.translation: 英伟达表示，其董事会没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充说黄仁勋致力于继续领导公司。黄仁勋表示将全面配合调查。

chunks.text: Well, our senior technology reporter Shauna McCullum is with me. Shauna, let's talk about Jensen Quang. How big of a deal is the company he runs, Nvidia?
chunks.hint: Shauna, Jensen Quang, how big
chunks.translation: 好的，我们的资深科技记者Shauna McCullum和我在一起。Shauna，我们来谈谈黄仁勋。他经营的公司英伟达有多重要？

chunks.text: Well, Nvidia has been run by Jensen Wang, one of the co-founders for the last 30 years, and he's been at the helm ever since. You know, he's a big deal in the tech world. He's known for wearing his leather jacket, getting selfies with uh, you know, adoring fans because the company is massive. It's one of the world's most valuable companies, valued at $4.5 trillion.
chunks.hint: co-founder, 30 years, leather jacket, $4.5 trillion
chunks.translation: 嗯，英伟达由联合创始人之一黄仁勋经营了30年，他一直掌舵至今。你知道，他在科技界是个大人物。他以穿皮夹克、和崇拜他的粉丝自拍而闻名，因为这家公司非常庞大。它是全球最有价值的公司之一，估值4.5万亿美元。

chunks.text: The chips that they're making used to be for video games, but now is propping up much of the AI, doing all that number crunching behind the scenes, that AI that we use every day from chat GPT to Claude H made by Anthropic. So, that's what the company is doing. That's what it's valued at. And Jensen himself has become also um you know in with all of the the world leaders. He's known as being a kind of tech voice, certainly an aid to President Trump.
chunks.hint: chips, video games, AI, world leaders, Trump
chunks.translation: 他们制造的芯片过去用于电子游戏，但现在支撑着大部分人工智能，在幕后进行所有那些数字运算，从ChatGPT到Anthropic制造的Claude H，我们每天使用的人工智能。所以，这就是这家公司在做的事情。这就是它的估值所在。而黄仁勋本人也成为了，嗯，你知道，与所有世界领导人在一起。他被认为是一种科技声音，当然是特朗普总统的助手。

chunks.text: So, who is the suspected Chinese spy Alice Hang, and when did she come into the picture? Here's Tessa Wong. The US chip company says it's investigating reports that its CEO Jensen Huang has had a close relationship with a woman named Alice Hang, an executive at a Singaporean company called Mega Speed.
chunks.hint: Alice Hang, Tessa Wong, close relationship, Mega Speed
chunks.translation: 那么，疑似中国间谍Alice Hang是谁，她何时进入画面？以下是Tessa Wong的报道。这家美国芯片公司表示正在调查有关其CEO黄仁勋与一位名叫Alice Hang的女性关系密切的报道，她是新加坡公司Mega Speed的高管。

chunks.text: Huang is a common Chinese surname. Here she is in May 2025, captured alongside Jensen Hang at a dinner that he hosted in Taipei. According to the New York Times, US officials believe that Ellis Hang has been working for China's spy agency, collecting information about Jensen Huang and American AI chips and possibly even trying to influence Nvidia.
chunks.hint: common surname, May 2025, dinner, spy agency, influence
chunks.translation: 黄是一个常见的中国姓氏。这是她在2025年5月，与黄仁勋在他于台北主持的晚宴上被拍到的画面。据《纽约时报》报道，美国官员认为Ellis Hang一直为中国间谍机构工作，收集关于黄仁勋和美国人工智能芯片的信息，甚至可能试图影响英伟达。

chunks.text: Now, we don't know much about Ellis Hang, but we do know that she also goes by her Chinese name, Huangla. And we also know that she has been linked to Mega Speed since 2023. Mega Speed is a big customer of Nvidia. It buys their chips and it runs data centers across Southeast Asia.
chunks.hint: Chinese name, Huangla, Mega Speed, customer, data centers
chunks.translation: 现在，我们对Ellis Hang知之甚少，但我们知道她也有中文名字黄拉。我们还知道她自2023年以来一直与Mega Speed有关联。Mega Speed是英伟达的大客户。它购买他们的芯片，并在东南亚各地运营数据中心。

chunks.text: But Megaspe's also been accused of granting Chinese companies backdoor access to Nvidia's chips, which they can't get due to US restrictions. Now, I have checked local business records and I found that a Chinese national named Hangler was Mega Speed's managing director from March to November 2023. A Singaporean man then took over the reigns.
chunks.hint: accused, backdoor access, restrictions, managing director
chunks.translation: 但Mega Speed也被指控给予中国公司后门访问英伟达芯片的权限，这些芯片由于美国限制他们无法获得。现在，我检查了当地商业记录，发现一位名叫Hangler的中国公民在2023年3月至11月期间担任Mega Speed的董事总经理。之后一位新加坡人接管了。

chunks.text: Earlier today, I tried to visit Mega Speed's office in Singapore's central business district, but I was denied entry. We've contacted Mega Speed for comment.
chunks.hint: visit office, denied entry, contacted
chunks.translation: 今天早些时候，我试图访问Mega Speed位于新加坡中央商务区的办公室，但被拒绝进入。我们已联系Mega Speed请其置评。

chunks.text: Well, someone who knows a lot about Jensen Huang is Steven Wit. He's an investigative journalist and author of a biography on Jensen Huang. Here's his blunt assessment. Uh, Jensen got played. Uh, you know, he fell for it.
chunks.hint: Steven Wit, investigative journalist, biography, blunt assessment
chunks.translation: 好的，一位非常了解黄仁勋的人是Steven Wit。他是一名调查记者，也是黄仁勋传记的作者。以下是他直率的评价。呃，黄仁勋被耍了。呃，你知道，他上当了。

chunks.text: Uh I think uh Miss Alice Wong is a woman who was running a big data center operation in Malaysia and and most of the chips that were shipped there were either diverted directly into China or used kind of illicitly and accessed by Chinese entities.
chunks.hint: Alice Wong, data center, Malaysia, chips, diverted
chunks.translation: 呃，我认为Alice Wong女士是一个在马来西亚经营大型数据中心业务的女人，而且运到那里的大部分芯片要么被直接转运到中国，要么被非法使用并被中国实体访问。

chunks.text: It should have been obvious that this woman had some red flags about her. She had no uh business background. She had no computer science background. Uh Megaspe just kind of came out of nowhere to start building these data centers. Um and so Jensen should have been much more concerned. But I think, you know, he fell for it and he got played. It's a it's a tale as old as time.
chunks.hint: red flags, no background, came out of nowhere, concerned
chunks.translation: 很明显，这个女人身上有一些危险信号。她没有商业背景。她没有计算机科学背景。Mega Speed不知从哪儿冒出来就开始建这些数据中心。所以黄仁勋本应更加担心。但我想，你知道，他上当了，他被耍了。这是个老掉牙的故事。

chunks.text: Well, let's take a closer look at the investigation that Nvidia has launched. Here's our North America technology correspondent, Lily Jamali. This investigation will be headed by independent directors on Nvidia's board with the help of outside counsel.
chunks.hint: investigation, Lily Jamali, independent directors, outside counsel
chunks.translation: 好的，让我们仔细看看英伟达发起的调查。以下是我们的北美科技记者Lily Jamali的报道。这项调查将由英伟达董事会的独立董事领导，并得到外部律师的帮助。

chunks.text: They have said in a statement on Sunday that they will be looking at all the facts, but they also expressed confidence in Mr. Wong and his leadership team. It appears that they want him to stay put. My sources tell me that there is so much money on the line and there is also no clear succession plan in place.
chunks.hint: statement, all facts, confidence, stay put, succession plan
chunks.translation: 他们在周日的一份声明中表示，他们将审视所有事实，但也表达了对黄先生及其领导团队的信心。看来他们希望他留任。我的消息来源告诉我，涉及的资金如此之多，而且也没有明确的继任计划。

chunks.text: Well, at a regular press briefing, China's foreign ministry spokesperson said Beijing would not comment further. We have already responded, he said, to this. The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative, and intended to smear and malign China.
chunks.hint: foreign ministry, no comment, groundless, smear
chunks.translation: 嗯，在例行新闻发布会上，中国外交部发言人表示北京不会进一步置评。他说，我们已经对此作出了回应。关于中国间谍的指控完全毫无根据、纯属猜测，旨在抹黑和污蔑中国。

chunks.text: There are questions about what the US president knew and his administration and when. The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Hang was spying on China's behalf. Yet in May this year, Jensen Huang joined Donald Trump's delegation of highlevel tech bosses to China after a reported lastminute invitation. This was the president's response when he was asked about the scandal.
chunks.hint: president knew, briefed, delegation, last-minute, response
chunks.translation: 有人质疑美国总统及其政府知道什么以及何时知道。《纽约时报》10月底报道称，特朗普去年已听取情报简报，称Alice Hang代表中国从事间谍活动。然而今年5月，黄仁勋在据报道最后一刻受邀后，加入了唐纳德·特朗普的高级别科技老板代表团访问中国。这是总统被问及丑闻时的回应。

chunks.text: President Nvidia is investigating Jensen Hang's relationship with a Chinese spy. Have you spoken to Jensen Hong today? I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what is going on. Um I'm sure I hope everything's fine there. He's done such an incredible job and uh so I would certainly hope he's a fine person in my opinion.
chunks.hint: spoken, fine person, incredible job, hope
chunks.translation: 总统，英伟达正在调查黄仁勋与中国间谍的关系。你今天和黄仁勋谈过吗？我没有和他谈过这件事。我只知道他是个好人，但你永远不知道发生了什么。嗯，我相信我希望那里一切都好。他做得非常出色，所以我当然希望他是我心目中的好人。

chunks.text: In hindsight, do you wish that you had acted on the intelligence when you were briefed about this? I don't think so. I think you know I think he's an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it. Yeah. You have to hear it. No, you can't do that with people. He was uh he's done an amazing job for our country.
chunks.hint: hindsight, acted, honorable, excuse, amazing job
chunks.translation: 事后看来，你希望你在听取简报时对情报采取行动吗？我不这么认为。我想你知道我觉得他是个体面的人。我想他大概有他的理由。是的。你得听听。不，你不能对人那样做。他呃他为我们的国家做了了不起的工作。

chunks.text: The US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has refused to comment when asked about Hang, but he was certainly the most senior figure in the administration talking it up. Robert Jameson is a congressional correspondent for the New York Times. He says there are now serious questions for the entire Trump administration.
chunks.hint: Marco Rubio, refused, senior figure, Robert Jameson, serious questions
chunks.translation: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在被问及黄仁勋时拒绝置评，但他无疑是政府中谈论此事的最资深人物。Robert Jameson是《纽约时报》的国会记者。他说现在整个特朗普政府面临严重问题。

chunks.text: We do know that the Secretary of State oversaw the drafting of the memo into Miss Wong and and the uh the relationship between her and the Nvidia CEO and the funneling of information back to China. So you, you know, you have to suspect that if the Secretary of State was involved, especially with such a close ally to Donald Trump, that the president was aware of what was going on.
chunks.hint: Secretary of State, memo, funneling, suspect, aware
chunks.translation: 我们确实知道，国务卿监督了关于黄女士以及她与英伟达CEO之间关系以及信息回流中国的备忘录的起草。所以，你知道，你不得不怀疑，如果国务卿参与其中，尤其是作为唐纳德·特朗普如此亲密的盟友，总统是知道正在发生什么的。

chunks.text: Um, I think when it comes to the fallout, this could not have come at a more interesting or almost perilous political time for the president and for Republicans in particular because the firewall of support around Donald Trump, the Congress, both chambers of Congress that have been solidly Republican and backing him at every turn for the last two years, has just flipped in favor of Democrats.
chunks.hint: fallout, perilous, firewall, Congress, flipped
chunks.translation: 嗯，我认为就后果而言，这对总统、尤其是对共和党人来说，时机再有趣不过，甚至几乎危险，因为围绕唐纳德·特朗普的支持防火墙——国会，过去两年一直坚定支持他的参众两院——刚刚转向支持民主党。

chunks.text: And so you've already seen top Democrats on the Banking Committee, which oversees the selling of chips, on the Foreign Relations Committee, which oversees international agreements between the United States and other countries, um, come out and say that they're going to aggressively investigate this and get to the bottom of what happened.
chunks.hint: Democrats, Banking Committee, Foreign Relations, investigate
chunks.translation: 所以你已经看到，监督芯片销售的银行委员会和监督美国与其他国家国际协议的外交委员会的高级民主党人站出来说，他们将积极调查此事，查明真相。

chunks.text: Well, since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep some of the most sophisticated advanced AI chips on the planet out of China's hands, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. That means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the lucrative Chinese market.
chunks.hint: export controls, advanced chips, competitive edge, locked out
chunks.translation: 嗯，自2022年以来，美国利用各种出口管制将一些全球最先进的AI芯片排除在中国之外，称这有助于保持美国的竞争优势并保护其国家安全。这意味着像英伟达这样的公司基本上被挡在了利润丰厚的中国市场之外。

chunks.text: Despite his apparent closeness to Trump, Huang has also not been able to get the administration's blessing to sell chips to China. Jensen Wang spoke to our economics editor Fisel Islam in September. Here he is on the battle for AI supremacy between the US and China.
chunks.hint: closeness, blessing, Fisel Islam, AI supremacy
chunks.translation: 尽管黄仁勋显然与特朗普关系密切，但他也未能获得政府批准向中国出售芯片。黄仁勋9月与我们的经济学编辑Fisel Islam进行了交谈。以下是他关于美中人工智能霸权之争的言论。

chunks.text: President Trump is very clear he wants America to win and and um President Xi wants China to win. Um, and it's possible for for both of them too. Uh, and the reason for that is because it's not a zero- sum game. Uh, the advance of of uh, human society is not a zero- sum game.
chunks.hint: Trump, win, Xi, zero-sum game, human society
chunks.translation: 特朗普总统非常明确，他希望美国赢，而习近平主席希望中国赢。嗯，两者都有可能。呃，原因在于这不是零和博弈。呃，人类社会的进步不是零和博弈。

chunks.text: And, and so I I think that for America to win the technology, the that win the AI race, particularly, it's important that, and President Trump sees this clearly, it's important that all AI companies that all AI research is built on the American tech stack.
chunks.hint: win AI race, important, American tech stack
chunks.translation: 所以我认为，美国要赢得技术，特别是赢得AI竞赛，重要的是，而且特朗普总统清楚地看到了这一点，重要的是所有AI公司、所有AI研究都建立在美国技术栈上。

chunks.text: And so if you would like if you would like America to be uh the global standard of technology just as we are the global standard of the of currency the US dollar then you're going to need to make sure that that people can access this technology uh from all over the world including China.
chunks.hint: global standard, technology, currency, access, China
chunks.translation: 所以，如果你希望美国成为全球技术标准，就像我们是全球货币美元的标准一样，那么你需要确保世界各地的人们，包括中国，都能获得这项技术。

chunks.text: Well let's get Fil's analysis shall we of that interview in light of the scandal we now know more about. It seems like quite openly from that that Jensen Wang had persuaded the president that it was a it wasn't about it was a bad idea to have blanket export bans and that you want to get you know you want to get the Chinese reliance on the US by selling it to them.
chunks.hint: Fil's analysis, persuaded, blanket export bans, reliance
chunks.translation: 好的，让我们请Fil结合我们现在更了解的丑闻来分析那次采访。从那次采访中似乎相当公开地看出，黄仁勋说服了总统，全面出口禁令是个坏主意，你想通过向中国出售芯片来让中国依赖美国。

chunks.text: Now a very different approach is being taken elsewhere in the administration. Others warning around the world that maybe you don't want to do this. there's all sorts of efforts by the Chinese to get hold of these chips through other methods and means. Um so so this is the background context to it but I think it's quite interesting to see that the central argument underpinning it he was quite open about Jensen Wang and uh and now that's all up for question.
chunks.hint: different approach, warning, other methods, central argument, up for question
chunks.translation: 现在政府其他地方采取了非常不同的做法。其他人警告说，也许你不想这样做。中国有各种努力通过其他方法和手段获取这些芯片。所以这是背景，但我认为很有趣的是，支撑它的核心论点，他对黄仁勋相当公开，而现在这一切都成了问题。

chunks.text: Well indeed so Sean then let's talk about President Trump's interest in this company. He took a stake in the company earlier this year. Yes that's right. He has shares in the company that was revealed in February. I believe it was um during the trip it showed that he had purchased $1.5 million worth.
chunks.hint: Trump's interest, stake, shares, February, $1.5 million
chunks.translation: 确实如此，那么Sean，我们来谈谈特朗普总统对这家公司的兴趣。他今年早些时候入股了这家公司。是的，没错。他在2月份被披露持有该公司股份。我相信是在旅行期间显示他购买了价值150万美元的股份。

chunks.text: Now the White House has said that has his administration takes care of those finances and it wasn't a direct choice by Trump. Um but you know they obviously also um decide which chips they they sell to China. So that's an interesting point.
chunks.hint: White House, finances, not direct choice, decide chips
chunks.translation: 现在白宫表示，他的政府处理这些财务，这不是特朗普的直接选择。嗯，但你知道他们显然也决定向中国出售哪些芯片。所以这是一个有趣的点。

chunks.text: I think the other point is you know what's the succession plan here? We're seeing this morning that the the boards are coming out and saying that they back Jensen Wang as the the leader of Nvidia and we know his daughter Madison, his son Spencer, his son-in-law also work at the company.
chunks.hint: succession plan, board backs, daughter, son, son-in-law
chunks.translation: 我认为另一点是，这里的继任计划是什么？今天早上我们看到董事会站出来说他们支持黄仁勋作为英伟达的领导人，我们知道他的女儿Madison、儿子Spencer、女婿也在公司工作。

chunks.text: He's previously said that, you know, he would want the the new CEO to be someone within with from within the company. There are a few people, you know, shining stars within Nvidia, but no kind of obvious successor. It's got quite a strange hierarchy and it's got quite a flat structure. So, a different kind of company structure to to a lot of others and so I think people will be watching to see you know how how it fares in the next few weeks um after perhaps the dust is settled or or perhaps not on this scandal.
chunks.hint: new CEO, within company, shining stars, flat structure, watching
chunks.translation: 他之前说过，你知道，他希望新CEO是公司内部的人。英伟达内部有几个闪耀的明星，但没有明显的继任者。它的层级结构相当奇怪，结构相当扁平。所以，与许多其他公司不同的公司结构，因此我认为人们会关注未来几周情况如何，也许在丑闻尘埃落定之后，或者也许不会。

chunks.text: And let's not forget this scandal comes at a turbulent time for the artificial intelligence industry and the markets. Last week, an enormous sell-off wiped trillions of dollars off AI stock values in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development. Here's the Financial Times columnist Jillian Ted on what all of this means for the markets.
chunks.hint: turbulent, sell-off, trillions, Democrat victory, Jillian Ted
chunks.translation: 别忘了，这起丑闻发生在人工智能行业和市场的动荡时期。上周，一场大规模抛售使AI股票市值蒸发了数万亿美元，部分原因是担心民主党在中期选举中获胜将意味着人工智能发展放缓。以下是《金融时报》专栏作家Jillian Ted谈这一切对市场意味着什么。

chunks.text: This comes at a moment when the AI sector is facing a lot more political scrutiny, particularly from the Democrats post midterms. You've got a lot of populist outrage about what's going on with the so-called tech bros and you have a sense that stock markets are massively overheated in relation to AI and if this causes the stock market bubble or the boom depending what your perspective is to burst the implications both in terms of the wider stock markets and the economic outlook will be really potentially very significant.
chunks.hint: political scrutiny, Democrats, populist outrage, overheated, bubble
chunks.translation: 这发生在AI行业面临更多政治审查之际，尤其是中期选举后来自民主党的审查。你对所谓的科技兄弟们的所作所为有很多民粹主义的愤怒，你有一种感觉，股市相对于AI已经严重过热，如果这导致股市泡沫或繁荣（取决于你的视角）破裂，对更广泛股市和经济前景的影响可能真的非常重大。

chunks.text: So this is much more than just one really badly timed, you know, very ill-conceived affair. It actually has a much bigger implication for the whole AI sector more widely. And that is all you need to know about Nvidia and Jensen Huang to this
chunks.hint: badly timed, ill-conceived, bigger implication, all you need
chunks.translation: 所以这不仅仅是一桩时机非常糟糕、考虑非常不周的婚外情。它实际上对整个AI行业有更广泛、更大的影响。这就是你需要了解的关于英伟达和黄仁勋的全部内容。
